note: Generated by tools/art/build.mjs (python3 tools/build.py art). Units are world units (the 1440 x 1000 stage) unless noted. Format: docs/STYLE.md section 9.

grid.note: Snap columns start at x0; a piece with footprint [w, h] cells at column c, row r has its anchor (bottom centre) at [x0 + (c + w/2) * cell, y - r * cell].

towerCrane.note: Move trolley, cable and hook together along x (trolleyRail). Cable: scaleY = length / cableLength about cableTop; hook: translateY by the same delta. Sway: rotate cable+hook about cableTop.

lever.note: up = hook rises, down = hook lowers

wreckingBall.note: Swing: rotate chain and ball together about tip (pendulum). Boom may tilt a few degrees about boomPivot. Drive: translate body, boom, chain and ball (and the wreck-cab seat) by dx.

excavator.note: Rotate the arm about armPivot, then the bucket about the arm tip (bucketPivot transformed by the arm rotation). Bucket variants: empty, full. The body piece can translate for driving; move all three.

dumpTruck.note: Bed variants are pre-rotated about bedPivot (degrees above). Dirt slides out at pour.

dig.note: Draw the dirt piece into a canvas; erase with a round brush (destination-out) along the bucket or finger path. Treasures sit in slots treasure-1..6 BELOW the dirt: draw them before the dirt canvas.

spawners.note: thrown onto the stage (rose-land) by the audience at a bow

curtain.note: Swap the three pieces' variants together (open/half/closed). A tween between states can scaleX each half about its outer edge (pivot) while swapping. Characters upstage of `line` (y < line) are hidden by the closed curtain (it is in the mid layer, baseline = line); the apron in front of it (line..lip) is where bows happen.

stage.note: The stage deck is the floor band between upstage and lip inside x0..x1 (same wall foot as the rest of the strip). The orchestra pit is in front of the lip, behind the pit rail (front layer).

spotlights.note: One piece, three copies (manifest pieces.spotlight.copies). Drag a copy along x (translate only); tap cycles colours. The cone pools on the stage at y = pool; a character whose x is within ~120 of a lit copy is "in the light".

backdrop.note: Swap by flying: translateY the piece up out of sight (to fly), swap the variant, drop it back with a thud and a dust puff at the deck.

slots.note: light switch dims this zone (nap time)

bus.note: Arrival: translate bus, bus-door and bus-inside together from off-screen left to rest; open the door; riders hop from bus seats to the kerb at stop. The bus is the travel vehicle (design 2.4).

sightWords.note: Blank cards: the engine writes SCHOOL.sightWords[i] into cards[i] (text layer + speech).

calendar.note: weather-today piece variants blank/sun/cloud/rain/snow; set class-window to the same weather. monthDots[0..11] are drawn with stars (days done), [12] is "today".

canvases.note: Paint/draw into a canvas over these boxes (blob save, P2d.3). The art underneath is blank paper / board.

rug.note: Seat ids start with rug: characters use the sit-cross pose. Each spot plays a note; a full rug plays a tune.

line.note: line-1 (by the door) is the leader; march right toward recess.

slide.note: Slide a seated character along path (world points, top to bottom), land sitting at the last point.

swings.note: Rotate chains and seat (and the seated character) together about pivot; push = bigger amplitude.
Rotate chains and seat (and the seated character) together about pivot; push = bigger amplitude.

seesaw.note: Variants are pre-rotated about pivot (degrees). Or rotate the level piece continuously; seats ride the plank ends.

monkeyBars.note: Hand-over-hand from grips[0] to the tower; the "made it" cheer on the deck (tower-deck surface).

rockingChair.note: Rock a few degrees about pivot, with the seated teacher.

sandbox.note: Same as the dig pit (site.js): draw the sand piece into a canvas, erase with a round brush; toys in treasure slots are drawn under it. A flipped full pail leaves a sand-castle prop.

lights.note: off = dim the classroom (nap time), lullaby.

wear.design: teal long-sleeve top; orange sleeves and side panels; an orange disc with a butter star on the chest; tealDeep swirl tone lines

site.paintNote: A piece's `paint` maps a paint colour to its variant ("{state}" = the piece's current state, e.g. the door's closed/open). Pieces without that colour keep their look. Rainbow paints stripes on blocks only.

theater.note: Costumes hang on the racks by their hanger hook (grip). Wear pieces: props[id].wear (rig piece, slot, colours per variant). The site hero set (hero-cape, hero-mask, hero-suit) is reused in the closet.

doneness.note: prep.cook[n] names the variant for doneness n. Toasty = warm caramel + grill stripes + a steam curl.
